thread:
Nadia (Product): Heads-up: rolling out SDK 4.1.1 tomorrow 08:00 PT. This is mostly docs + small runtime tweak: normalized error codes for malformed function calls and a docs rewrite for the connector examples.

Ravi (Eng-runtime): Runtime change: we now return structured error codes `ERR_FUNC_SYNTAX` / `ERR_FUNC_ARGS` instead of freeform text for function-call failures. Backwards compatibility: string message still included, but automated parsers should switch to codes.

Sam (DevEx): I'll update the public examples and client helpers to parse the new `code` field. Publishing a migration note: "If you rely on exact error strings, move to structured codes by referencing our new error mapping table."

Priya (Support): Any customer-facing language already? We had a ticket this week where a customer relied on message parsing for retry logic. Need a short blurb for the support playbook.

Nadia (Product): Drafted FAQ and sample responses at internal docs link: https://intranet.redwood/docs/sdk-4-1-1-error-codes (internal). Key message: behavior is more stable; update parsers within 30 days.

Ava (Legal): Quick check: nothing here affects contracts or SLAs. Good to go.

release-bot: Release window reserved: 1729056000 -> 1729063200. Canary region: eu-west-1 for the first 3h, then global. Monitor errors for service-level regressions.

Ravi (Eng-runtime): Note for infra: the new code field is emitted in the same payload root; no schema bump needed. We added telemetry to flag clients still searching for regexes on error strings. We'll surface a list in 7 days.

Sam (DevEx): Public changelog entry drafted. Snippet for quick migration:
```js
// old check (string match)
if (resp.error && resp.error.message.includes('invalid args')) { retry() }
// new (stable)
if (resp.error && resp.error.code === 'ERR_FUNC_ARGS') { retry() }
```

Priya (Support): Adding canned reply and a triage tag for tickets. Will proactively contact customers who used server-side parsing last quarter.

Nadia (Product): Thanks all. Plan: canary eu-west-1 08:00 PT -> 3h monitor -> 25% -> 100% within 36h if green. Docs published at 08:15 PT. Please report anything unexpected in #eng-runtime or this thread. :rocket:
